headline: iOS 17 code suggests you can replace Siri with ChatGPT or Claude
summary: New code found in iOS 17 suggests Apple may allow users to swap out the default Siri AI for third-party models like ChatGPT or Claude.
details: Code discovered within iOS 17 indicates that Apple might be planning to allow users to replace the built-in Siri voice assistant with alternative AI models.
This potential change, if implemented, would enable users to choose between Siri and popular large language models such as OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude.

The discovery suggests a significant shift in Apple's approach to its AI assistant, potentially opening the door for greater customization and integration of third-party AI services within the iOS ecosystem.
While the code points to this possibility, it remains to be seen whether Apple will officially announce or implement this feature in future iOS updates.
